messages:
Olivia: Need a quick decision on the Azure Marketplace private offer for the Edge Appliance + Redwood Dedicated credits bundle. Hard deadline: submit by next Friday. Main open items: hybrid commit structure (commit + overage), discount breakpoints, renewal credit mechanics, HW co-marketing embargo, and SI-approved pilot path.

Diego: Sales preference: allow 3 commit flavors — 12mo standard, 24mo annuity, and a short POC bucket (120d) for SI-backed pilots. Suggest breakpoints by annual committed spend: Platinum >= $1.2M, Gold $600k-1.19M, Silver $200k-599k, Bronze <200k.

Hannah: Finance angle: hybrid commit OK if we model a minimum monthly draw + metered overage at list price with discount applied to committed portion only. Proposed base discounts (24mo / 12mo / POC): Platinum 22%/18%/3% credit, Gold 16%/12%/2%, Silver 10%/7%/1%, Bronze 5%/3%/0. Cap any HW partner kicker so net effective discount <= 30%.

Vik: HW partner requests: 30-day review of co-branded assets + 60-day embargo on joint case studies post-launch. They also want the appliance SKU to appear in the offer metadata (so customers can filter by "appliance"). They asked about a marketing co-investment in exchange for a +3% HW rebate applied as platform credits.

Sasha: Legal flags: (1) Renewal credits must be opt-in at purchase; no automatic stacking with marketplace promo codes or one-off sales credits. (2) POC bucket should require SI attestation to avoid abuse; onboarding credits subject to clawback if customer cancels within 6 months. (3) Add an embargo breach remedy with notice/cure and right to pause co-marketing.

Priyanka: Marketing can work with a 60-day embargo on case studies (preferred) but needs final partner logo + creative by Wed to hit our Oct event window. If partner accepts +3% co-invest, we can co-fund a joint webinar.

Tariq: For rollout, Sales Ops needs SKU mapping + which accounts want POC bucket. Also need a clear formula for renewal credit application so CRM automation can apply correctly. I'll prepare a template.

Diego: Sales asks whether the HW rebate should be a platform credit (non-transferable) or visible as a marketplace discount. Prefers platform credit to keep flexibility, but customers sometimes ask to see the savings on the invoice.

Hannah: Platform credit is fine; we'll surface an "effective discount" field in our internal pricing docs. Public-facing invoice language to be coordinated with Finance/Legal.

Vik: Partner prefers the platform credit model as well (they want the rebate shown as partner co-investment in the joint one-pager, not a line item discount).

Sasha: I'll draft three short clauses today: renewal opt-in, onboarding clawback, embargo remedy. Quick review needed from Finance + Partnerships.

Priyanka: If legal is good, Marketing will prepare two co-brand one-pagers (customer-facing and internal enablement) and a partner FAQ. Need to know embargo dates to set PR timeline.

release-bot: Reminder: Azure Marketplace private offer submission window closes in 7 days. Attach signed PO + T&Cs to the submission bundle.

Olivia: Action items (summary):
- Finance (Hannah): final discount table + net cap and invoice language.
- Legal (Sasha): draft opt-in + clawback + embargo clauses.
- Marketing (Priyanka): co-brand one-pagers + announce cadence draft.
- Sales (Diego/Tariq): SKU mapping, list of POC candidates, CRM automation formula.
- HW Partner Manager (Vik): confirm partner sign-off timeline and co-invest confirmation.

Diego: I'll surface 5 deals that want the POC bucket by Tue.

Hannah: I'll upload the pricing model and sample clawback calc to Drive and post link here when ready.

Vik: Partner will confirm co-invest and embargo timeline within 48 hours.

Sasha: Drafts will be in the drive by EOD today for quick team comments.

Olivia: Goal = finalize and submit by Friday EOD. Post blockers here. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
